name: BACH_0188_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (71%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Blurred simulated frozen section is out-of-distribution, cannot exclude Normal, and defers margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 71%, Normal 19%, Invasive 7%, Benign 4% (ECE 5%) [F1] | Leans InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate InSitu from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD, blur 3 [F6] | Suspect input (AUROC 70%) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 0/5 InSitu (4 Normal, 1 Benign; 78%–81%) [F5] | Neighbors favor Normal, Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.18, contribution -0.39; 19/20 check) [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (+0.30); unreliable 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (1.05, +0.15); unreliable 0/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) on simulated frozen section mimics atypia; all 5 nearest cases are Normal or Benign.
- Deeper levels or recut H&E reveal normal lobules or invasion missed with cell segmentation disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 9, 8, 11**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (8%, 5%, 3%, 3%) to exclude invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 9, 2**: Check duct atypia vs Normal; defer lateral (100%), inferior (98%), superior (83%) margins.
3. **Regions 1, 11**: Verify benign stroma and lobules; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
